entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought recently.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I have your order right here. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They're just not working out for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats every which way, but after every ride, I'm getting painful blisters on my heels. They seem to be a poor fit for my foot shape.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me just check your delivery date... okay, I see they were delivered 30 days ago. You're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.

Okay, that's great news. Now, since I did have to deal with the discomfort and now the hassle of packaging these up and sending them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? I still need to buy another pair of cycling shoes from you.

I understand the request, Alex. However, my system doesn't allow for discount codes on standard returns related to fit. I can confirm I've approved the full refund for the item, and I'm sending you a pre-paid return label right now so there will be no shipping cost on your end.
I see. So there's no flexibility on that? Not even a 10% coupon for the trouble? It feels like a reasonable ask.

I do apologize, but for this type of return, a full refund is the authorized solution. I'm not permitted to add a goodwill credit on top of that. Once we receive the shoes, that refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Alright, fair enough. The refund was the most important part anyway. I appreciate you processing it quickly. Please send that label over.
Of course. The email is on its way to you now. It will have all the instructions you need. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day!
